entries.zh: 无因；没有缘由、无端
entries.en: there is no cause; without reason, causeless

entries.zh: 无来由；没有来由、无缘无故
entries.en: there is no cause; groundlessly, without any reason

entries.zh: 无来路来；没有来路、无路可来
entries.en: there is no road/way to come by; no way through

entries.zh: 无路去；无路可走、走投无路
entries.en: there is no road to go; no way out

entries.zh: 无几；没有多少、寥寥无几
entries.en: there is not much; hardly any

entries.zh: 无向多；没有那么多、不多
entries.en: there is not much; not so much
entries.notes: H“無向多”字面组合罕见，义据 L“no ay mucho”与 M 音综合拟定。

entries.zh: 无母；没有母亲（丧母）
entries.en: has no mother; motherless
entries.notes: 西栏 no ay principal（无首领）与 H/M“无母”不合，据 H/M 两栏互证定义，L 存疑。

entries.zh: 无他故；没有别的事故、别无他事
entries.en: there is no other matter; nothing else is the matter

entries.zh: 那只个；只有那一个、仅此而已
entries.en: there is nothing more than this; only this one

entries.zh: 欠一件白白个；白欠一件、徒然欠着一物
entries.en: there is not a single real (coin); (Hokkien idiom) owed one for nothing
entries.notes: 西汉对应松散，“白白个”取“徒然/无端”义，据四栏综合拟定。

entries.zh: 讨无入头；找不到借口、无从开脱
entries.en: there is no way to excuse it; no pretext to be found

entries.zh: 断人行；行人断绝、路上无人往来
entries.en: no one passes by; the passage of people is cut off
entries.notes: M 首音调标污损（T99），L“por dormido”文义不清，据 H“斷人行”与 L“no ay quien pase”互证定“无人通行”义。

entries.zh: 断蹄迹；踪迹断绝、不见蹄印行迹（“蹄”字存疑，或作“即”）
entries.en: there are no traces; all tracks/footprints cut off
entries.notes: H“蹄/即”存疑且 M 首音调标污损（T99），据 L“no ay rastros”（fuenga 疑即 huella，蹄印/踪迹）定“断绝踪迹”义。

entries.zh: 空口；空着嘴没有东西吃、空腹无食
entries.en: empty mouth; having nothing to eat

entries.zh: 空食；没有饭吃、空口无食（morisqueta 指白饭）
entries.en: no more plain boiled rice; nothing (more) to eat

entries.zh: 白食；白口吃饭、只吃白饭无菜（一说白吃他人饭食不付钱）
entries.en: plain rice eaten bare, without relish; (alt.) eating at another's expense
entries.notes: “白食”兼“白饭无菜”与“白吃（不付钱）”两解，L 与 15 条同为 morisqueta（白饭），两解并存。

entries.zh: 最无用；毫无用处、无利可图
entries.en: utterly useless; of no benefit or profit

entries.zh: 危乱；危乱不安、没有太平
entries.en: no peace; peril and disorder

entries.zh: 不平定；未平定、不得安宁（不太平）
entries.en: not pacified or settled; no peace or security

entries.zh: 掺无一物；用手捞抓却一无所得
entries.en: to grasp with the hand and get nothing; to come up empty-handed
entries.notes: M 首音残缺（[残]/T99），L 文句亦讹乱（no cojer…con la mano），据 H“掺无一物”定“捞取无所得”义。

entries.zh: 金（禁）饿；久不进食而耐得住饿、不以为苦
entries.en: to endure hunger; to go long without food and not mind it
entries.notes: H“金餓”之“金”按 L“久不食而不以为意”推断同“禁餓（耐饿）”，字义依赖推断故降置信。

entries.zh: 忖（首字残）；忖度、猜测（勿妄加揣测）
entries.en: to conjecture; to guess
entries.notes: H 首字残缺（[残]）、M 首音难辨，据 L“no coniecturar”与“忖”字定“揣测”义，原词全貌存疑。
